attributes.board_name: Missouri State Board of Registration for the Healing Arts – Advisory Commission for Physical Therapists

rules.accepted_credit_types: No pre-approval; organized programs with goals/objectives, qualified presenters, subject matter integrally related to PT practice. Automatically accepted: APTA and its components/state chapters/specialty sections, other state PT associations, AMA, AOA, FSBPT. Also: accredited academic coursework with grade C or better (10 h per semester credit, 8 per trimester credit, 7 per quarter credit), post-graduate clinical residency (1 h per hour), APTA or other national specialty certification/recertification (30 h in the period awarded), and other activities listed in 20 CSR 2150-3.203. 1 hour = 50-60 minutes.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt from half (15 hours) for the year the licensee graduated from a CAPTE-accredited program; temporary licensees are exempt until fully licensed.
rules.audit_note: Attest under oath on the renewal form; keep records 4 years after the reporting period; Board audits. Extension requests must be filed before December 31 (then complete by Feb 28, document by March 10).
rules.notes: The rule defines 1 CEU = 10 clock hours (30 hours = 3 CEUs). Reporting period is the 24 months January 1 (odd year) to December 31 (even year); compliance is reported in even-numbered years. A licensee who has not completed and reported the 30 hours may not practice unless an extension is granted. No mandatory topics.
